SELECT fiscal_year, fiscal_period, fiscal_week, min(calendar_date), max(calendar_date), count(*)
FROM dim_date WHERE fiscal_period=2 AND fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales, SUM(CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN n.net_sales END) AS web, count(*) AS n
FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, count(*) AS line_rows, count(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) AS distinct_ids, count(DISTINCT (f.receipt_id, f.line_no)) AS distinct_rcpt_line, min(f.etl_loaded_at), max(f.etl_loaded_at)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 1,2

WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(w.dispatch_date, f.sale_date) AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
    LEFT JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id<>999 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
),
mine AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, CASE WHEN n.store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END AS grp, SUM(n.net_sales) AS mine
    FROM net_lines n JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=n.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL
),
ctl AS (
    SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN 'web' ELSE 'stores' END AS grp, SUM(r.net_sales) AS ctl
    FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=r.business_date
    WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') AND r.store_id<>999 GROUP BY ALL
)
SELECT m.*, c.ctl, m.mine-c.ctl AS diff FROM mine m LEFT JOIN ctl c USING (fiscal_year, fiscal_week, grp) ORDER BY 1,2,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week, d.calendar_date, d.day_name, d.is_trading_day, d.holiday_name,
       count(DISTINCT CASE WHEN r.store_id<900 THEN r.store_id END) AS stores_trading,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id<900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS stores_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=900 THEN r.net_sales END) AS web_net,
       SUM(CASE WHEN r.store_id=999 THEN r.net_sales END) AS s999
FROM dim_date d LEFT JOIN rpt_daily_store_sales r ON r.business_date=d.calendar_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27')
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,3

SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_week,
  SUM(CASE WHEN s.store_id=999 OR p.category='ZZ Test' THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) AS excluded_net,
  count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.net_amount<0) AS neg_lines, count(*) FILTER (WHERE f.quantity<=0) AS nonpos_qty
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=f.sale_date
WHERE d.fiscal_period=2 AND d.fiscal_year IN ('FY2025/26','FY2026/27') GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2

SELECT ty.fiscal_year AS fiscal_year, 2 AS fiscal_period, ty.fiscal_week,
       ty.net_sales AS this_year_net_sales, ly.fiscal_year AS last_year_fiscal_year, ly.net_sales AS last_year_net_sales,
       ROUND(100.0*(ty.net_sales/ly.net_sales-1),1) AS growth_pct
FROM weekly ty JOIN weekly ly ON ly.fiscal_week=ty.fiscal_week AND ly.fiscal_year='FY2025/26'
WHERE ty.fiscal_year='FY2026/27' ORDER BY ty.fiscal_week
